Name: PixelHag's Mobile Phone Themes
Author: PixelHag
Description:
I got bored a while back and downloaded a ton of brushes for Krita and went a little crazy making all kinds of stuff so I decided to turn it all into a new pack for Mobile Phone. Gotta love those run-on sentences! Oh, I also grabbed a bunch of sounds from Pixabay I thought were cool, too. 

Farmhouse in the banner is the lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28918]Brayflox Farmhouse (CP & AT)[/url] by the talented [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/madishartte?gameId=1303]madishartte[/url].

All art is mine, here's some of the brush sets I used if you're curious:

[url=https://krita-artists.org/t/fizzyflowers-essential-brushset-version-2-with-400-brushes-cloud-paint-hair-fur-fx-foilage-trees-leaves-texture-smudge-and-more/38580]FizzyFlower Essential Brushes v2 [/url]
[url=https://krita-artists.org/t/lilly-mist-s-special-brushes/50772]Lilly Mist's Special Collection[/url] 
[url=https://krita-artists.org/t/brush-pack-for-comics-and-illustrations/78427]Lilly Mist's Comics & Illustrations Bundle[/url]
﻿
All of these are free btw, including Krita! 

My favorite audio converter: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/fallout4/mods/3663]MultiXwm[/url]
